questions.question: Why did Daniel refuse the king's food and wine?
options: He feared the food had been poisoned
He was fasting for the coming festival
He resolved not to defile himself with it
He had no appetite after the long journey
questions.answer: He resolved not to defile himself with it

questions.question: What did Daniel and his friends eat instead, and with what result?
options: Vegetables and water; they appeared healthier than the others
Only the king's own rich portion, and yet they fell ill at once
Bread alone, and they grew faint and weary by the day
Meat and rich wine, yet they wasted away to nothing
questions.answer: Vegetables and water; they appeared healthier than the others

questions.question: God gave Daniel and his three friends learning, skill, and wisdom, and Daniel understanding in visions and dreams.
Daniel resolved not to _____ himself with the king's food.
The three friends were renamed Shadrach, Meshach, and _____.
